summary: RAG coverage scaffold + champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1
hypothesis: Combining the ragCoverageScaffold in-context topology (exp006) with the best-performing LoRA adapter (v2a_e1) should yield additive gains — the adapter's learned quality plus the scaffold's structured retrieval coverage ought to outperform either alone.
technique: A matrix sweep crossing the ragCoverageScaffold inference topology (RAG + coverage scaffold prompt, from exp006) with the champion LoRA adapter v2a_e1 at greedy decoding, evaluated on the full-30 held-out set.
result: Scored 0.336 on the full-30 greedy gate — above the raw exp006 baseline (0.290) but well below the champion exp056 (0.440). The cross did not yield additive gains; discarded, confirming the scaffold topology does not complement the LoRA adapter as hoped.
